scripts.dev:frontend: cd apps/frontend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:backend: cd apps/backend && npm install && npm run dev
scripts.dev:setup:ai: cd apps/ai-service && ([ -d venv ] || python3 -m venv venv) && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:db: cd infra && docker compose up -d mongo
scripts.docker:logs:backend: cd infra && docker compose logs -f backend
scripts.docker:logs:frontend: cd infra && docker compose logs -f frontend
scripts.docker:logs:ai: cd infra && docker compose logs -f ai-service
